design.problem: P24B froze the intake protocol and P24CR repaired the handover until P24C's three probes measured it SUFFICIENT. What no artifact carried was the thing a run is written down IN, and the arithmetic that turns records into the one number the acceptance bar is stated in. Until now that bar was a sentence in a document nobody could recompute from evidence
design.twoArtifacts: planning/external-consumer-run-record.json is the closed schema, owned by a single deepEqual in the frozen test and stored canonically at two-space indent with one trailing newline. tools/check-external-consumer-run-record.mjs is the executable half: builtins-only (node:crypto, node:fs, node:path), no repository import, no ambient environment, no clock, no random source, no spawn, so a team copies that one file out and runs it on its own records wherever they are, with a byte-identical transcript that carries no host path
design.additive: the fenced protocol block in docs/external-consumer-intake.md is unmoved to the byte and stays pinned at sha256 cc90f1376fde4f525520ac7b22ce541569f6f45b9fecff7732c28ffa5fd7edd8. The document gained prose under its EXISTING Owner help and Evidence headings only; no heading was added, no key was added to the block, and neither new artifact was appended to requiredInputs, because a record is what a run PRODUCES and not an input a team is handed
design.digests: evidence is sha256 over the evidence file's bytes unmodified; a record's identity is sha256 over ONE canonical serialization at schema-declared key order, two-space indent, trailing newline, UTF-8, so the same record with its keys shuffled has the same identity and one changed value does not. Evidence is resolved against the record's own directory, never the working directory, so a record decides the same way whatever the checker was launched from. Identity is the RECORD's and never the team's, which is exactly why identity and counting are taken by different keys
design.outcomesAndDispositions: three outcomes are recordable and only completed can be accepted. A well-formed record gets one disposition from a closed six-value vocabulary: accepted; observed:owner-help, because a run that measured the payload plus a person is a different measurement, recorded rather than laundered to zero; not-accepted:abandoned, because a team that stopped is a run that happened, kept with its reason and counted toward nothing; and void: plus one of the protocol's own three falsification ids, each void keeping its own distinct fail code so an unrecorded help event and a contradicted tally never collapse into one. A record declaring itself void must SHOW that falsification in its own fields or be refused OUTCOME_REASON_INCOHERENT: a void nobody can see is a label, not a falsified run
design.countByTeam: teamsCountedInSuppliedRecords is DERIVED as the number of distinct teamId values among supplied accepted records, because the protocol's bar is three independent TEAMS and a team that takes the payload twice is one team, not two. Duplicates count once, every non-accepted disposition counts zero, and the derivation is over the records handed in on a command line and is never the project's total
design.failClosedNeverAccepts: exit 1, empty stdout, exactly one anchored RUN_RECORD_ERROR:<CODE> line and no verdict anywhere. Nine codes: MISSING_ARGUMENT, RECORD_UNREADABLE, RECORD_SCHEMA_VIOLATION, OUTCOME_REASON_INCOHERENT, PARTICIPANT_NEVER_COUNTED, HELP_EVENT_OMITTED, HELP_COUNT_CONTRADICTION, EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, EVIDENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH. A run falsified while claiming it completed carries its void disposition on that line; a malformed file carries none, because it is not a record of a run. The checker states WELL_FORMED and derives a number; it never accepts a run, and its transcript carries validationIsAcceptance false in its own bytes

ownerFacing.once: P24B'de disaridaki bir ekip icin kural seti yazildi, P24CR'de o ekibe verilen kutu tamamlandi. Ama bir kosu gerceklesirse nereye, hangi alanlarla yazilacagi hicbir yerde tanimli degildi; 'uc bagimsiz ekip, sifir sahip yardimi' cumlesi kagitta duruyordu ve kimse onu kayitlardan yeniden hesaplayamiyordu.
ownerFacing.simdi: Iki sey var. Biri kosu kaydinin kapali sekli: hangi alanlar, hangi sonuc degerleri, kanit dosyasinin ozeti. Digeri o kaydi okuyan tek dosyalik denetleyici; sadece Node'un kendi kutuphaneleriyle calisiyor, bu depodan hicbir sey ice aktarmiyor, saat ve rastgelelik kullanmiyor, yani bir ekip o dosyayi kopyalayip kendi kayitlarinda calistirabiliyor.
ownerFacing.fark: Sayi artik iddia degil, hesap; ve dogru birimden hesap. Bar 'uc bagimsiz EKIP' oldugu icin sayim ekip kimligi uzerinden yapiliyor: ayni ekip iki kez kosarsa bir ekip sayiliyor. Kosunun uc sonucu var. Bitirdiyse tamamlandi, birakti ise 'kabul edilmedi: birakildi' diye nedeniyle saklaniyor, gecersizse hangi ihlalin gecersiz kildigi yaziliyor. Sadece tamamlanmis ve kimsenin yardim etmedigi kosu kabul edilebiliyor. Sahip yardim ettiyse kayit bozuk sayilmiyor, 'gozlemlendi: sahip yardimi' diye etiketleniyor; sifira yuvarlanmiyor.
ownerFacing.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM'in 'musteri olustur' aksiyonunu paketleyip disaridaki bir ekibe verdigimizi dusunun. Ekip kutuyu alip formu calistirdi, kaydetti, bir kayit reddedildi, tekrar denedi ve bitirdi. Bugune kadar bunun sonucu sadece birinin anlattigi bir hikayeydi. Artik ekip tek bir dosyaya yaziyor: kosu kimligi, EKIP kimligi, katilimci turu, paket surumu, sonuc ve nedeni, sahip kac kez yardim etti, her yardimin dort alani ve kanit dosyasinin parmak izi. Kanit dosyasina sonradan tek bir bosluk eklenirse parmak izi tutmuyor ve kosu gecersiz oluyor. Ayni kayit iki farkli klasorde farkli sirada yazilmis olsa bile kimligi ayni cikiyor. Ayni ekip ikinci kez kostuysa iki ayri kayit oluyor ama sayimda yine bir ekip.
ownerFacing.kalanEngel: Bu paket bir kosuyu KAYDEDECEK yeri kuruyor, kosuyu yapmiyor. Testteki her kayit birkac saniye once yazilmis sahte ornek. Disaridan sayilmis ekip sayisi hala 0, sahip yardimi hala olculmedi, P24 hala acik. Paketi yazmayan taze bir reviewer onayi ve CI'daki ikinci tam QA bekleniyor.
